comments.body:
[A10] Assignment for [A668] on #200. Lane from processor main 93fb0b2d.

Do exactly what the issue requires:
- The wrong-type GET_AVB_INFO answers NOT_SUPPORTED (status 11), echoed at its own length.
- An AVB_INTERFACE index that does not exist still answers NO_SUCH_DESCRIPTOR, and a command shorter than cdl 16 still answers BAD_ARGUMENTS. Keep the order: length, then type, then existence.
- Update the command model, F06.14 (through its generator), `tb/aecp_cmds/decode.json` (re-recorded by its recorder), the compliance review section 8 item 12 with the clauses in the issue, and the V5 rows of `tb/pp_top`.
- The microcode ROM must stay byte-identical, or the change must be explained.

Run the gates the change touches, plus the repository's full `make check`. Then run the parent consumer gate: a committed local scratch clone of milan-fpga dev a032c6d6 with this head as the protocol-processor gitlink, never pushed, running milan_dp. Report the area delta of `protocol_processor_top`, which should be about 0.

STOP if any gate fails for a reason other than the status change. Post TAKEN, then REVIEW READY or STOP, on #200.
